description: The line plot titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = small” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) performance across six training epochs for three different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper small model: “small AdaLoRA_int4”, “small AdaLoRA_int8”, and “small int4”. The x-axis, labeled “epoch”, ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis, labeled “WER”, spans from 25.0 to 42.5, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The “small AdaLoRA_int4” line (orange circles, solid line) begins at approximately 35.5 WER at epoch 0, peaks at 42.5 at epoch 2, then steadily declines to 31.5 by epoch 6. The “small AdaLoRA_int8” line (orange squares, dashed line) starts at 30.0, rises slightly to 33.2 at epoch 1, then drops sharply to 25.5 at epoch 5 before rising slightly to 26.0 at epoch 6. The “small int4” line (orange circles, dashed line) begins at 30.0, dips to 28.5 at epoch 1, then gradually declines to 25.2 at epoch 6. All lines show a general downward trend after epoch 2, indicating improved transcription accuracy with continued training, though “small AdaLoRA_int4” exhibits the highest WER throughout most of the training.
